meta.homeTitle: Check your USCIS case status — and actually understand it
meta.homeDescription: Enter your USCIS receipt number for a live case status, explained in plain English, with a timeline and typical processing times. Free, no account needed.

home.heading: Check your USCIS case status
home.subheading: Live status straight from USCIS, explained in plain English — with your timeline and what to expect next.

howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.step1Body: The 13-character number on your USCIS notice, like IOE0912345678.
howItWorks.step2Body: We read your current status the moment you ask — not from a stale copy.
howItWorks.step3Body: Plain-English meaning, what to do next, and how long cases like yours take.

forms.heading: Forms we track
forms.body: Green cards, work permits, citizenship, travel documents and more.

errors.empty: Enter your receipt number to continue.
errors.tooShort: Receipt numbers are 13 characters. You have {count}.
errors.tooLong: Receipt numbers are 13 characters. You have {count}.
errors.badPrefix: "{prefix}" isn't a USCIS receipt prefix. Check the first three letters.
errors.badFormat: That doesn't look like a receipt number: 3 letters then 10 digits.

case.title: Case {receipt}
case.unknownOffice: A USCIS office we don't have a public name for
case.processingRange: Cases like yours ({form}) typically take about {low}–{high} months according to published USCIS processing times.
case.processingProgress: You appear to be about {months} months into processing.
case.processingDisclaimer: These are published USCIS ranges, not a prediction for your case. Times vary by office, form category, and workload.
case.mockBannerBody: Live USCIS credentials are not configured on this environment, so you are seeing a realistic demo status. Add USCIS_CLIENT_ID and USCIS_CLIENT_SECRET to check real cases.

nearby.title: Nearby cases in our corpus
nearby.body: Of {count} cases in the same receipt block we have seen so far:

track.title: Get email alerts when this case changes
track.body: Free. Confirm once by email — we'll only write when USCIS updates the status.
track.successConfirm: Check your inbox and confirm the link to start alerts.
track.successAlready: This case is already being tracked for that email.
track.errorGeneric: We couldn't start tracking right now. Try again in a moment.

errors.notFoundBody: USCIS has no record for this receipt number. Double-check the letters and digits on your notice, then try again.
errors.upstreamBody: We couldn't reach USCIS. This is usually temporary — wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.rateLimitedBody: You've checked several cases in a short time. Please wait a few minutes, then try again.

auth.signInBody: We'll email you a magic link — no password. Free forever.
auth.linkSent: If that email can receive mail, a sign-in link is on its way.
auth.errorGeneric: We couldn't send a sign-in link. Try again shortly.

dashboard.title: My cases
dashboard.subtitle: Cases you're tracking. Alerts stay free.
dashboard.empty: You're not tracking any cases yet. Check a receipt, then tap “Track this case”.
dashboard.statusUnknown: Status not synced yet — open the case to refresh.

seo.statusHubDescription: Plain-English guides to common USCIS case status messages — what they mean and what to do next.
seo.statusHubBody: Every common USCIS status, explained without legal jargon. Pick a message to learn what it means for your case.
seo.processingHubDescription: Published USCIS processing time ranges by form — context for how long cases like yours typically take.
seo.processingHubBody: These ranges come from published USCIS processing times. They are not a prediction for your specific case.
seo.processingUnavailable: We don't have published ranges for this form yet.

insights.title: USCIS activity insights
insights.description: What our growing case corpus is seeing — counts and recent status changes.
insights.body: Built from live lookups and polite rechecks. Free forever. Numbers grow as people check cases.
insights.feedEmpty: No status changes recorded yet. Check a sandbox case or wait for cron rechecks.
